# Ramjan Ali Akash

> Local SEO & AI visibility for local businesses. The site explains services, industries, locations, pricing, case studies, and practical search-marketing guidance.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://ramjan-ali-tracker.ramjan-ali.workers.dev/): Overview of local SEO and AI visibility services.
- [Services](https://ramjan-ali-tracker.ramjan-ali.workers.dev/seo-services): All available SEO services.
- [Local SEO](https://ramjan-ali-tracker.ramjan-ali.workers.dev/local-seo): Local search and Google Maps service.
- [AI visibility](https://ramjan-ali-tracker.ramjan-ali.workers.dev/ai-search): Visibility in AI-assisted search experiences.
- [Industries](https://ramjan-ali-tracker.ramjan-ali.workers.dev/industries): Local-business industries served.
- [Locations](https://ramjan-ali-tracker.ramjan-ali.workers.dev/locations): Country and city service coverage.
- [Pricing](https://ramjan-ali-tracker.ramjan-ali.workers.dev/pricing): Service plans and pricing.
- [Case studies](https://ramjan-ali-tracker.ramjan-ali.workers.dev/case-studies): Case-study and playbook library.
- [Blog](https://ramjan-ali-tracker.ramjan-ali.workers.dev/blog): Local SEO and AI search guides.
- [About](https://ramjan-ali-tracker.ramjan-ali.workers.dev/about): Information about Ramjan Ali Akash.
- [Contact](https://ramjan-ali-tracker.ramjan-ali.workers.dev/book-a-call): Project enquiry and call booking.

## Discovery

- [XML sitemap](https://ramjan-ali-tracker.ramjan-ali.workers.dev/sitemap.xml): Canonical index of published pages.
- [Robots policy](https://ramjan-ali-tracker.ramjan-ali.workers.dev/robots.txt): Crawler access rules.

## Usage notes

- Prefer canonical URLs from the XML sitemap.
- Treat service descriptions, pricing, and availability on their linked pages as authoritative.
- Do not access `/admin` or `/api` routes.
